asOf: 2026-09 (levels.fyi US medians spot-checked 2026-09-26; BLS OEWS May 2024 w/ May 2025 cross-check)
units: annual median total compensation (base + bonus + annualized stock); intern = monthly pay x 12

OpenAI.note: PPU/equity valued at tender price; small sample

Anthropic.note: equity at latest private valuation; small sample

Jane Street.note: SWE/trader similar at entry; traders diverge upward later

Susquehanna (SIG).note: SIG SWE pay is lower than trader pay

Microsoft.note: 59-60=entry,61-62=mid,63-64=senior,65-66=staff,67-68=principal; title 'Principal' spans 65-67 -> use staff unless level 67+

Nvidia.note: grant-date values; realized pay far higher after 2023-25 stock run-up

ByteDance / TikTok.note: US figures; for China offices apply countryMultipliers.china

Databricks.note: equity at latest private round; tenders make it semi-liquid

Palantir.note: flat titles; stock run-up inflates realized pay

Oracle.note: IC2 MTS=mid, IC3 Senior MTS=senior, IC4 Principal MTS=staff, IC5 Consulting MTS=principal

Applied Materials.note: also used for KLA / Lam Research

JPMorgan Chase.note: Chase retail branch titles -> occupations.retail_service / financial_advisor; tech Analyst ~$111K, Assoc ~$135K, VP ~$220K

Evercore.note: elite boutiques pay ~5-10% above bulge bracket

BlackRock.note: asset manager; much lower than PE/HF

Kaiser Permanente.note: tc = tech/corporate track; physicians/RNs -> occupations (NorCal Kaiser RNs ~$170K+, TPMG physicians ~$350K)

Genentech.note: scientist track: Research Associate=entry, Scientist=senior, Sr/Principal Scientist=staff/principal

teacher_k12.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (HS ~$64.6K, elem ~$62.3K; HS mean $73.7K)
teacher_k12.note: CA avg teacher pay ~$100K (NEA); use regionMultipliers

professor.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 postsecondary teachers median $83,980 (incl. adjuncts); AAUP FCS 2024-25 full-time faculty averages

postdoc.source: NIH NRSA FY2025 stipend (yr0 $61,008); UC-UAW postdoc scale (NIH+2 steps)

graduate_student.source: UC Berkeley dept. PhD stipends ($41K-$50K/yr 2025-27); BLS postsecondary teaching assistants mean $47,560 (May 2024)

student.source: estimate: part-time/campus jobs; internships use ladder level 'intern'

nurse_rn.note: SF Bay Area RNs are the highest paid in US (~$165-190K median); multiply by 1.75 for Bay Area

physician.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (family med $238K, pediatrics $210K, anesthesiology mean $337K; many top-coded >=$239,200); Medscape 2026 report: avg $386K (primary care $298K, specialists $417K)

resident_physician.source: AAMC housestaff survey 2024-25 (PGY1 ~$67K national; UCSF/Stanford PGY1 ~$85K+)

surgeon.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 surgeons mean $371K (median top-coded); Medscape 2026 (ortho ~$550K+)

dentist.note: practice owners and specialists earn more

lawyer.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (p90 top-coded >=$239,200; biglaw/partners above)

biglaw_associate.source: Cravath scale (2025): $225K yr1 -> $435K yr8 base + $20-115K bonus; equity partners $1M+
biglaw_associate.note: match on employer name + attorney title

small_business_owner.source: estimate: Census ABS / SBA Advocacy self-employment income ranges; very wide variance
small_business_owner.note: business equity often dominates net worth

government_employee.source: OPM FedScope 2024 avg federal salary ~$106K; BLS OEWS state/local government medians ~$60-65K

military.source: DoD Regular Military Compensation (basic pay + BAH + BAS + tax adv.), 2025 pay tables

retail_service.source: BLS OEWS May 2024/2025: retail salespersons ~$35K, cashiers ~$32K, fast food ~$31K, waiters ~$35K

artist_musician.source: BLS OEWS May 2024: fine artists median $60,570 (wage earners only), musicians $42.45/hr typically part-time; most artists are self-employed and earn less

content_creator.source: estimate: creator-economy surveys (Goldman Sachs 2023, Linktree 2022/NeoReach) -- only ~4% of creators earn >$100K
content_creator.note: use creatorBands by follower count instead when follower data exists

engineer_non_software.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (civil ~$99.6K, mechanical ~$102K, electrical ~$112K, aerospace ~$135K)

data_scientist_general.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (data scientists ~$112.6K; analysts lower)

hr_recruiter.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (HR specialists; HR managers ~$140K)

public_safety.note: Bay Area police/fire often $150K+ with overtime

skilled_trades.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (electricians ~$62K, plumbers ~$63K, construction laborers ~$46K)

driver_delivery.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (heavy truck ~$57K; gig drivers lower)

pilot.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (airline pilots; p90 top-coded)

farmer_rancher.source: BLS OEWS May 2024 (farm managers; small farms often far less)

executive_general.source: BLS OEWS May 2025 chief executives ($102.88/hr median; p90 top-coded)
executive_general.note: use ladder 'exec' with company/tier when employer known

retired.source: estimate: Census CPS 65+ income (SS + pensions + withdrawals)
retired.note: income is a poor proxy -- use age-based wealth priors (Fed SCF) for retirees

regionMultipliers._appliesTo: occupations (national BLS medians). Company/tier tc already assume SF/NYC/SEA.

countryMultipliers._cols: [techTcVsUS, generalWageVsUS] nominal USD; tech = same company/level on levels.fyi

creatorBands._units: annual creator income USD by max follower count across platforms (median, p90) -- rough

_source: levels.fyi US medians (spot-checked 2026-09-26), street data for IB/MBB, BLS OEWS May 2024 for occupations. Data source: Levels.fyi (https://www.levels.fyi).
